# laravelforge_permission (Data Source)

Fetches a single assignable permission from the global Laravel Forge permissions catalog by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the permission.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Permission name.
